do_not: Do not replace detector math with generic spot-price spread.

detectors.gp: family detector exact criterion → compatible graph adapter
detectors.rd: Batch orders; pool state; clearing constraints; fee model; auction deadline.
detectors.edc: Solve clearing allocation/price maximizing feasible surplus subject to pool invariant, order limits and conservation; compare settlement value after costs.

detectors.gp: family detector exact criterion → compatible graph adapter
detectors.rd: Current supply/state; bonding curve parameters; mint/redeem fees; external executable quote.
detectors.edc: For supply q and cost function C(q), marginal price p(q)=dC/dq; exact acquisition/redeem cost is integral/difference C(q+Δ)-C(q). Compare against executable external value.

detectors.gp: family detector exact criterion → compatible graph adapter
detectors.rd: sqrtPriceX96; active liquidity; initialized ticks/tick bitmap; fee tier; decimals; QuoterV2 or exact local tick traversal.
detectors.edc: Piecewise quote across initialized ticks using sqrtPrice, active liquidity L and fee tier; route Q_R(x) must traverse ticks exactly or use protocol quoter.

detectors.gp: family detector exact criterion → compatible graph adapter
detectors.rd: Reserves; invariant bounds; fees; exact competing route.
detectors.edc: x+y=k inside the valid inventory region; quote is locally constant-price until a reserve boundary, then infeasible. Detect cross-venue executable deviation net of fees.

detectors.gp: family detector exact criterion → compatible graph adapter
detectors.rd: Reserves; token ordering/decimals; pool fee; exact route legs; gas.
detectors.edc: For reserves (x,y), k=x·y. Exact-in quote with fee γ: Δy = y·(γΔx)/(x+γΔx). Route profit uses exact composition, not spot reserve ratio.

detectors.gp: family detector exact criterion → compatible graph adapter
detectors.rd: Per-leg protocol adapter/state; exact route; same-block snapshot; gas.
detectors.edc: Compose protocol-correct quote adapters across heterogeneous invariants. No common spot formula; opportunity iff exact closed-route net profit >0.

detectors.gp: family detector exact criterion → compatible graph adapter
detectors.rd: Protocol-specific dynamic parameters; state snapshot; exact adapter; fees; oracle where protocol requires.
detectors.edc: Q(x;θ(S_t)) with θ read from current contract state (weights, fees, peg, oracle or hybrid book). Reconstruct exact current invariant before comparing routes.

detectors.gp: family detector exact criterion → compatible graph adapter
detectors.rd: Active bin; bin step; per-bin reserves/liquidity; variable fee state; exact bin traversal.
detectors.edc: Traverse discrete price bins; each bin uses constant-sum behavior at fixed bin price, with fixed+variable fee. Aggregate fills across bins until amount is satisfied.

detectors.gp: family detector exact criterion → compatible graph adapter
detectors.rd: PMM state/inventory; oracle/reference price; k/curve parameters; fees; exact protocol version.
detectors.edc: Use protocol PMM inventory-aware curve around oracle/reference price; quote exact buy/sell branch and compare executable round-trip net of fees.

detectors.gp: family detector exact criterion → compatible graph adapter
detectors.rd: All pool balances; amplification A; fees/admin fees; token rates/decimals; exact invariant version.
detectors.edc: Use protocol StableSwap invariant D/A and solve post-trade y (Newton iteration as protocol does); compose exact dy across legs and optimize net route profit.

detectors.gp: family detector exact criterion → compatible graph adapter
detectors.rd: Long-term order state; last virtual execution time; reserves; block timestamp; fees.
detectors.edc: Advance virtual long-term orders to target block/time, derive post-state reserves, then run exact quote/round-trip on that state.

detectors.gp: family detector exact criterion → compatible graph adapter
detectors.rd: Virtual reserves; mark/index/oracle; funding; position constraints; fees.
detectors.edc: Use virtual reserves/invariant plus index/mark/funding rules; opportunity is hedged net basis, not raw virtual reserve spread.

detectors.gp: family detector exact criterion → compatible graph adapter
detectors.rd: Balances; normalized weights; swap fee; token scaling factors; exact pool type/version.
detectors.edc: Balancer invariant V=Π_i B_i^{W_i}; derive exact outGivenIn from balances/weights/fees and evaluate route net profit.

detectors.rd: CEX derivative book; mark/index/funding; DEX exact spot quote; margin/inventory; fees.
detectors.edc: Hedged net basis/funding: Π=DerivativeLeg+SpotLeg+expected_funding-carry-fees-slippage-settlement risk.

detectors.rd: CEX L2/orderbook or firm quotes; DEX exact route quote; fees; inventory; latency; transfer/hedge model.
detectors.edc: Π(q)=CEX_bid_VWAP(q)-DEX_buy_exact(q)-CEX/DEX fees-transfer/hedge costs, or reverse direction. Require firm depth and settlement/inventory model.

detectors.rd: Spot and derivative firm books; mark/index; rates/carry; funding; expiry; fees; margin.
detectors.edc: Compare derivative price to carry-adjusted spot/forward replication; for perp include expected funding. Opportunity is hedged net convergence after margin, fees and funding.

detectors.rd: Funding schedule/rate; perp and spot books; borrow rate; margin; horizon.
detectors.edc: Expected net over horizon H: funding receipts - spot/perp basis convergence risk - borrow/carry - fees - slippage. Require hedgeable books.

detectors.rd: Option bid/ask by strike/expiry; spot/forward; rate/dividend/carry; contract multiplier; fees.
detectors.edc: European no-income core: C-P = S-PV(K). Conversion/reversal/box compare executable legs with same strike/expiry and financing/dividend adjustments.

detectors.rd: Full option surface bid/ask; strikes; expiries; spot/forward; rates; depth.
detectors.edc: Enforce strike monotonicity/convexity and calendar consistency on executable bid/asks; e.g. equally spaced K: C(K1)-2C(K2)+C(K3)≥0. Trade violating butterfly/calendar only if all legs executable.

detectors.rd: Contract payoff; mark/index/settlement oracle; expiry; position/margin state; executable hedge.
detectors.edc: Compute deterministic payoff/settlement value under venue rules and compare with executable acquisition/hedge/unwind cost; include liquidation penalty and expiry timing.

detectors.rd: Auction price/curve; remaining lot; deadline; collateral/external value; unwind liquidity.
detectors.edc: Π(q,t)=FairExecutableValue(q)-AuctionPurchaseCost(q,t)-UnwindCost(q)-Gas; solve feasible q and timing under auction rules.

detectors.rd: Independent timestamps; fast/slow quotes; volatility estimate; execution latency; firm liquidity.
detectors.edc: Trigger z=(p_fast-p_slow)/σ only identifies divergence; opportunity requires a firm executable quote/route and Π_net>0 before stale side updates.

detectors.rd: Oracle round/update; protocol state; affected positions/pools; post-update quotes; oracle freshness.
detectors.edc: Recompute protocol state under confirmed oracle update O_t→O_{t+1}; evaluate resulting executable liquidation/repricing routes. Oracle delta alone is not profit.

detectors.rd: Event/receipt/log; pre/post state or deterministic transition; affected pools/routes; exact quote adapters; gas.
detectors.edc: Apply confirmed/public event transition S'=T_e(S), quote all affected routes on S', then Π_R(x;S')=Q_R(x;S')-x-C_R(x). Never infer profit from event size alone.

detectors.rd: Protocol event/state variables; before/after block state; affected claims/pools; redemption/execution path.
detectors.edc: Given deterministic transition e, compute S'=T_e(S); revalue all claims/routes V(S') and compare executable acquisition/unwind cost. Emit only if transition is known and settlement executable.

detectors.rd: Batch intents; limit prices; token graph; external quotes; settlement constraints.
detectors.edc: Find feasible matching/clearing maximizing total surplus across orders plus external liquidity, subject to conservation and individual limit-price constraints.

detectors.rd: Auction start/end price/time; current timestamp; firm external quote; competition/latency.
detectors.edc: Given auction price P(t), execute when external executable value V(t)-P(t)-costs is maximized subject to deadline/competition and min surplus.

detectors.rd: Explicitly authorized/private order feed; bundle contents; settlement rules; route quotes.
detectors.edc: Only evaluate flows explicitly available to this searcher; price the authorized order/bundle against alternative settlement and costs. No inference of privileged/private data.

detectors.rd: Intent/order constraints; balances/approvals; external liquidity; gas; valid-to; settlement contract.
detectors.edc: maximize user/solver executable surplus under limit prices, token conservation, balances and settlement constraints; compare AMM/CLOB/RFQ routes.

detectors.rd: Auction lot/price curve; collateral; protocol debt; deadline; market liquidity.
detectors.edc: Π(q,t)=ConservativeCollateralValue(q)-AuctionCost(q,t)-UnwindCost(q)-Gas-capital risk; solve lot size and timing under exact auction rules.

detectors.rd: Collateral/debt token exchange rates; protocol oracle; repayment/redemption functions; market quotes.
detectors.edc: Value debt/collateral claims in common numeraire using protocol conversion/redemption, then compare executable acquisition/repayment paths net of costs.

detectors.rd: Account collateral/debt; liquidation thresholds/bonuses; oracle prices; close factor; firm unwind route; gas/flash fee.
detectors.edc: Eligibility via protocol health metric (Aave: HF=(collateral value×weighted liquidation threshold)/borrow value; liquidation when HF<1). Π=seized collateral executable value-debt repaid-gas-flash/unwind costs.

detectors.rd: LTV/liquidation threshold; supply/borrow rates; collateral factor; loop fees; gas.
detectors.edc: Optimize leverage n / LTV to maximize net APY or finite-horizon P&L subject to health-factor/risk buffer and borrow/supply rate feedback.

detectors.rd: Supply/borrow indices and rates; utilization; collateral/margin requirements; fees; market hedge.
detectors.edc: Net carry over horizon H = earned supply/yield - borrow cost - protocol fees - hedge/transaction costs - capital/risk charge.

detectors.rd: Prediction AMM invariant; outcome IDs; firm order book; complete-set mechanics; resolution source.
detectors.edc: Quote conditional-token AMM exactly and compare with firm outcome order-book quotes for identical payout claim; net of split/merge, fees and settlement.

detectors.rd: Outcome partition; collateral denomination; firm bid/ask per outcome; split/merge/redeem availability; fees.
detectors.edc: For exhaustive mutually exclusive outcomes backed by 1 collateral unit: buy all if Σ asks_i + fees < 1; mint/sell all if Σ bids_i - fees > 1, respecting split/merge/redeem mechanics.

detectors.rd: Canonical event identity; resolution rules; outcome mapping; firm books; fees; settlement horizon.
detectors.edc: Normalize markets only if they reference the same event, resolution source and payout semantics; then compute firm cross-venue spread after fees/capital lockup.

detectors.rd: Outcome payoff matrix; logical relation/event mapping; firm quotes; resolution rules.
detectors.edc: Represent outcome payoffs as linear constraints; solve LP for a portfolio with non-negative state payoff and negative acquisition cost (after fees), or detect violated logical probability bounds.

detectors.gp: NFT/asset venue graph; settlement token filter
detectors.rd: NFT AMM curve/state; eligible token set; marketplace firm quotes; royalties; fees.
detectors.edc: Use exact NFT AMM bonding curve quote for acquisition/unwind and compare against firm marketplace bid/ask for same eligible asset/collection, net of royalties/fees.

detectors.gp: NFT/asset venue graph; settlement token filter
detectors.rd: Listings; trait metadata; firm bids; sale history; royalty/fees; redemption if applicable.
detectors.edc: Floor/trait deviation is only a signal. Emit only when a firm buyer/bid or deterministic redemption converts it into Π_net>0; otherwise observe-only.

detectors.gp: NFT/asset venue graph; settlement token filter
detectors.rd: TokenId identity; executable listing/ask and bid; royalties; marketplace fees; ownership/approval state.
detectors.edc: For identical tokenId/asset, Π=firm exit bid proceeds-acquisition ask-royalty-marketplace/gas costs; no floor proxy allowed for the exit leg.

detectors.gp: NFT/asset venue graph; settlement token filter
detectors.rd: Loan state; liquidation rules; oracle/appraisal; firm NFT bid/liquidity; gas.
detectors.edc: Eligibility from lending protocol; Π=conservative firm-bid value of seized NFT-debt repayment-liquidation/gas/unwind costs. Floor alone cannot be profit.

detectors.gp: NFT/asset venue graph; settlement token filter
detectors.rd: Fractionalization/redemption contract; bundle composition; firm component bids; fees.
detectors.edc: Π=deterministic redeem/unbundle value-acquisition cost-component unwind costs; inverse path for mint/bundle-and-sell if contract permits.

detectors.hs: No hot opportunity seed; telemetry evidence only
detectors.rd: Telemetry/evidence only; no fabricated private flow, reorg certainty, future resolution or unavailable external data.
detectors.edc: No is_opportunity=true. Emit structured evidence only until a lawful, deterministic, executable settlement path and required public/authorized data are present.

detectors.rd: convertToAssets/Shares; previewDeposit/Redeem; maxDeposit/Redeem; vault totalAssets; share/asset market quotes.
detectors.edc: Use preview/convertToAssets and convertToShares plus actual deposit/redeem limits/fees; compare executable share market price to redeemable asset value.

detectors.rd: Protocol exchange/redemption rate; withdrawal queue/delay; underlying price; firm LST quotes.
detectors.edc: Π=RedemptionValue(exchange_rate,t)-MarketAcquisitionCost-queue/carry/fees; cross-LST uses a common underlying redemption unit.

detectors.rd: Component weights/holdings; redemption/mint rules; firm component quotes; fees.
detectors.edc: NAV from exact redeemable components; Π=RedeemValue(token)-MarketCost(token)-unwind/fees, or inverse mint-and-sell path.

detectors.rd: Mint/redeem functions/rates; market quotes; fees/caps; oracle if protocol uses one.
detectors.edc: Compare executable market price with protocol mint/redeem conversion after fees and caps: Π=max(RedeemValue-MarketBuyCost, MarketSellProceeds-MintCost)-costs.

detectors.rd: PT/YT/SY exchange rates; expiry; mint/redeem path; firm PT/YT quotes; underlying APY.
detectors.edc: Core parity: P_PT+P_YT≈P_underlying (same accounting asset, same maturity). Also implied APY from PT/YT exchange rate; evaluate mint/redeem + market legs net of fees.

detectors.rd: wrap/unwrap conversion; exchange rate; fees; underlying and wrapper firm quotes; bridge state if bridged.
detectors.edc: Compare exact wrap→sell and buy→unwrap paths against wrapper conversion ratio, fees and delay. Opportunity iff closed economic value >0.

detectors.rd: Maturities; redemption values; market prices; yield indices/APY; fees; settlement path.
detectors.edc: Convert each claim to discount factor / implied yield for common underlying and maturity basis; detect executable curve violations after carry, fees and settlement delay.

detectors.rd: Basket composition/weights; mint/redeem contract state; exact component quotes; fees; redemption constraints.
detectors.edc: NAV=Σ_i w_i·V_i (or exact redemption outputs). Π=ExecutableRedeemOrMintValue-BasketAcquisitionCost-all_costs. Emit only if mint/redeem or firm unwind exists.

detectors.rd: Full ordered route legs; per-leg protocol adapter; reserves/slot0/ticks/bins; token decimals; pool fees; same-block state; gas; optional flash fee.
detectors.edc: Q_R(x)=q_n(...q_2(q_1(x))); Π_R(x)=Q_R(x)-x-C_R(x). Opportunity iff max_x Π_R(x)>0. Marginal prefilter: Σ_e[-ln((1-fee_e)·rate_e)]<0.

detectors.rd: Orders/intents; limit prices; balances; valid-to; external liquidity quotes; settlement constraints.
detectors.edc: maximize total executable trader surplus subject to limit prices, token conservation and settlement constraints; compare internal matching vs external liquidity.

detectors.rd: Two competing paths with full legs; exact per-leg quotes; fees; block-consistent pool state; gas delta.
detectors.edc: Δ(x)=Q_indirect(x)-Q_direct(x)-C_incremental(x); evaluate both executable paths at identical input/state; opportunity iff max_x Δ(x)>0.

detectors.rd: Firm bids/asks or RFQs; depth ladder; quote timestamp; venue fees; settlement latency/cost; DEX exact quote where applicable.
detectors.edc: Π(q)=Proceeds_bid(q)-Cost_ask(q)-taker_fees(q)-settlement_cost(q)-hedge_cost(q). Prices must be VWAP/depth-aware, not top-of-book only.

detectors.rd: Parallel executable paths; exact quote functions; gas activation cost per path; shared input amount.
detectors.edc: maximize Σ_j Q_j(x_j)-C(x_1..x_m), subject to Σ_j x_j=x and x_j≥0; compare optimum against best unsplit route.

detectors.rd: Bridge quote/fee; message/finality state; source/destination liquidity; delay distribution; inventory/capital.
detectors.edc: E[Π]=DestinationValue-SourceCost-bridge_fee-gas-carry-CVaR(latency/finality/reorg). Must model non-atomic settlement and failure states.

detectors.rd: Cross-domain oracle/state timestamps; finality; firm routes; bridge/inventory settlement model.
detectors.edc: Normalize same economic claim across domains; discount for timestamp/finality and require an executable settlement path. Signal deviation alone cannot emit.

detectors.rd: Per-chain firm quotes; inventory balances; finality/latency; gas; settlement status; accounting FX.
detectors.edc: No atomic bridge assumption: aggregate independently executable legs using inventory on both domains. Π=Σ proceeds-Σ costs-carry/finality/hedge costs.
